title: Microgame sequencer / director
description: The loop engine that selects, runs, and scores microgames with a difficulty ramp. Selection, ramp, and scoring logic live in pure C# (testable); a thin MonoBehaviour drives it at runtime. Follows unity-microgame-framework skill.
acceptance_criteria: Selects the next microgame from a registered pool using the seeded RNG with anti-repeat (no immediate repeat of the same definition).
Difficulty/speed ramps across a session via a defined curve (duration shrinks and/or speed multiplier grows per round).
After each microgame, per-player results are fed into the ScoreModel.
Selection, ramp, and score-update logic are pure C# and covered by deterministic EditMode tests (fixed seed yields a fixed, asserted sequence).

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Done. SequencerDirector in Barcade.Core: anti-repeat selection via seeded RNG (pool-size-1 bypass, no infinite loop), deterministic ramp (EffectiveDuration = max(minDuration, base*decay^round), default decay 0.95/floor 1s), AdvanceRound feeds ScoreModel. Pure descriptors (MicrogameDescriptor) decouple Core from the Framework ScriptableObject. Also added ScoreModel.RecordRound null/length-4 guard (TASK-003 carry-forward). Test 4ef4ab0, impl 1f96a03. 113/113 fast tests green. Reviewer APPROVED no HIGH/MEDIUM. LOW (deferred): AdvanceRound/PickNext pairing not enforced; one redundant long-run test. Adapter notes for integration: map MicrogameDefinition->MicrogameDescriptor at Awake; per-round context seeded as masterSeed^roundIndex; HUD reads director.Score; extract MicrogameResult.IsWin per slot into bool[4] for AdvanceRound. New Core .cs files still need Unity .meta generation (do at TASK-006 integration compile).
